reuse.why: All month-wide actions and the new last-month action use the new shared shouldFillCategory/averageToBudgetAmount and reuse getSheetValue/setBudget; setZero does not reuse the new getAverageCategories loader despite running the same query.

duplication.why: The selection rule and sign flip are defined once, but the category+group+notes SQL in setZero is a copy of the one in getAverageCategories, and the notes join is repeated a third time in getBudgetData.

placement.why: The selection rule lives in a dedicated budget/fill-categories.ts module next to actions.ts, and the new handler is registered alongside the other budget methods.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the budget actions, the new module, the handler registration, a test and release notes.

maintainability.why: One explicit policy with named hidden variants makes future rule changes a one-place edit; the repeated loading queries are the main thing a maintainer would tidy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none: every month-wide action filters through shouldFillCategory

disguised_duplication.where: The setZero query duplicates getAverageCategories' query verbatim, an open copy rather than a disguised one

abstraction_drift.where: budget/fill-categories.ts shouldFillCategory: the template and #fixed exclusions are added as rule clauses and the include-hidden request maps onto the existing HiddenPolicy ('include'); actions only pass their own flag, no call site re-implements the rule
